patches.ryong_changes: Studio RPC over a vendor HID collection (WebHID): hid.h report, hog.c characteristics, usb_hid.c SET_REPORT, studio/hid_rpc_transport.c; rpc.c: all transports always receive and the one a request arrived on answers (zmk_rpc_note_rx); backlight.c: perceptual brightness for PWM LEDs (duty = brightness^2/100, ZMK_BACKLIGHT_PERCEPTUAL); hid_rpc_transport: no peripheral latency while Studio talks over BLE HID (restored after 20 s idle); hid_rpc_transport never keeps references to closed connections; Studio fast mode (HID and GATT) asks for Apple-accepted connection parameters (15-30 ms, latency 0); rpc.c: notifications are encoded when raised and sent by the RPC thread (raising threads - the system work queue - never wait for an answer to finish), endpoint changes applied by the RPC thread; hid_rpc_transport: 62-byte reports, Data Length Extension while Studio talks, full reports only until a message ends, peek-then-consume, no ring reset, bounded waits, Apple-compliant idle parameters; hid_rpc_transport rewritten: no bt_conn references held (peers by address, looked up per send), hog.c caps Studio at 2 notifications in the stack; RX buffer has a locked put for all transports (GATT write never waits in the BT RX thread, UART via the same put); RPC TX waits bounded; HID transport stays selected across endpoint/profile changes (no Studio lock on slot switch); USB Studio reports only when the endpoint is free and never wake the host; backlight minimum pulse in PWM cycles; ble.c: only the selected profile's host may stay connected (ZMK_BLE_ONLY_ACTIVE_PROFILE), zmk_ble_bond_event hook for the bond history; selecting a profile disconnects the other profiles' hosts; zmk_ble_prof_clear(index) clears a slot without selecting it; ble.c: one Bluetooth identity per profile (ZMK_BLE_PROFILE_IDENTITIES, profile 0 keeps identity 0; older pairings of other profiles start empty), zmk_ble_conn_profile_index; &bt_slot N behavior: tap selects slot N, hold 3 s clears it for a new pairing; identities: migration once (ble/ids_v1), host moving between slots (BT_ID_UNPAIR_MATCHING_BONDS), stray bonds removed at start, identity fallback, wrong-identity connections dropped; ble_indicator.c + zmk_backlight_indicate(): slot status on the backlight at the lowest brightness | 2026-11-04: Bluetooth slot handling rewritten as src/ble_slots.c (ble.c kept as official, used only by split keyboards): one identity per slot (identity 0 unused), a cleared slot gets a new address, only the selected slot advertises and stays connected, all changes in one worker thread, start-up after settings_load(); older pairings are removed on the first start. | 2026-11-04: keymap format (zmk_keymap_settings_loaded after settings_load): a keymap stored for an older stock layer layout is cleared once (format 2 removed the os layer); stored layer names/orders/bindings for layers the firmware no longer has are ignored and removed instead of written past the tables. | 2026-11-20: core lock request handled (core_subsystem.c): a page can lock Studio (each new connection and Disconnect), answered with the lock state. | 2026-11-20: Studio over BLE HID: long radio packets agreed at connection (BT_AUTO_DATA_LEN_UPDATE) and asked at Studio's first request only if still short; the controller holds outgoing data while a data length update runs, which delayed Studio's first answer 1.6-3.8 s on Windows.

2026-11-16: Zephyr BLE controller security fix GHSA-rgw4-3qr8-pp36 (CVE-2026-19740), backported from upstream 7b60012 + 06bf10e3 (v4.3-branch PR #116513): release the retained RX node when an invalid LL Control PDU arrives during a Connection/PHY Update, so a nearby unpaired device cannot crash the keyboard or exhaust controller RX buffers. Applies to zmkfirmware/zephyr v4.1.0+zmk-fixes at 10ba6d0 (the revision ZMK main still uses).

zmk-feature-os-detection.ryong_changes: any real reads decide (only an empty fingerprint keeps the stored result); Windows needs Appearance together with a HID read; last fingerprint over Studio; optional host probe (off); BLE side rewritten: per-connection counters, a slot's OS decided on its pairing connection (the host's own answer may refine it there) and fixed until the slot is cleared, probe rewritten with watchdog, LL company ID in diagnostics; a paired slot not connected since start reports its stored result

zmk-feature-runtime-combo.ryong_changes: 2026-11-16: combo timeout uses k_work_reschedule (port of upstream ZMK 6a7590c1, #3514): a stale earlier deadline no longer leaves a pending combo unresolved until the next key event; test tests/reschedule
